messages:
sam: KorbinTech procurement pinged — POC require SOC2 Type II (redacted), ISO27001 cert summary, and a signed pen-test attestation. They want everything by EOW. Any standard packet we can hand off?
eli: We have the SOC2 redacted export and an ISO summary. I can attach both. Who owns the attestation?
marie: Security here. We can sign a scoped attestation for production inference endpoints only. Need to confirm vendor will share redacted report & sign NDA. Also request 30-day remediation window.
dave: Legal flag: include limitation "no implied warranty" and keep attestation limited to the named scope. Also we'll want the attestation signed by Security + Legal.
security-bot: Uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/korbintech/poc/soc2-redacted-2026-03.pdf (sha256: def456)
ops: Ops can produce inventory of prod hosts for scope redaction. ETA tomorrow 17:00 UTC.
sam: Korbin also asked whether we can accept a vendor-redacted report only (they indicated the vendor refuses to share raw). Are we OK with vendor-redacted?
marie: We accept vendor-redacted reports as long as the vendor confirms scope and methodology. Need vendor name + test dates.
eli: I'll ask Korbin to have the vendor send a confirmation email and sign NDA to security@redwood-inference.com.
dave: Draft attestation below (please review):
```
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that [Vendor] performed a penetration test against the production inference endpoints in scope: [redacted]. The vendor report will be shared with Redwood under NDA. Findings identified will be remediated within thirty (30) days of disclosure to Redwood. This attestation is limited to the scope described and does not constitute any warranty or guarantee. For questions contact security@redwood-inference.com.
```
marie: Good. Add cert issuance date for SOC2 (2025-11-15) and an ISO27001 summary line. Eli pls redact the cert number.
eli: Done. I'll attach the ISO summary and SOC2 now + a 1-page timeline for procurement.
security-bot: Attached timeline: s3://redwood-evidence/korbintech/poc/evidence-timeline.pdf
sam: One more ask from procurement: can we include an estimate for time-to-fix if medium/high findings surface? They want to understand procurement risk.
marie: We can't promise timelines for unknown findings. We can provide a statement: typical remediation window is 30 days; critical items are triaged immediately and may require longer depending on customer impact.
dave: Add "remediation timeline depends on severity and may require additional approvals" line.
ops: Host inventory ready: s3://redwood-evidence/korbintech/poc/host-inventory-redacted.csv (ETA now).
eli: I'll package SOC2 redacted, ISO summary, attestation draft, timeline, and host inventory into a procurement packet and send to KorbinTech. Sending as redwood-poc-packet-korbintech.zip
sam: Thanks team — I'll update KorbinTech procurement and ask for vendor NDA + confirmation. Will follow up if they push the deadline. :thumbsup:
